name: inc-vector
note: FROZEN for every regime, plus the inclination channel on GEO scoring the inclination-vector step (i cos RAAN, i sin RAAN): inc_z_min 30, inc_step_min_deg 0.02. Chosen on a train-only grid (inc_z_min 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 30 by inc_step_min_deg 0.003, 0.005, 0.008, 0.011, 0.015, 0.02): train north-south hits were 6 of 17 at every point, so the rule (most train north-south hits with train GEO false alarms at most 4 and east-west hits at least 36, ties to the strictest) took the strictest point
